narrative: A black-letter bill on the post by the Bull, title only, the paper whole. Your eye is on the title. No author's name is printed, and none is written in the margin. The bill beside it. The lower corner is torn away, a pipe-light's worth, the tear old enough to have softened. Title only. No author.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read both titles and went back to the lodging.
